items.claim: He possesses very good kicks at range and accurate combinations that often include kicks.
items.quote: Very good kicks at range. He's got good accurate combinations he can put together often including the kicks

items.claim: He is an excellent counter striker who capitalizes when opponents step in to engage.
items.quote: he can also counter strike very well. Oftentimes it's because he's controlling the range, and when somebody steps in to try to engage with him, that's when he counters them on the way in.

items.claim: He is the best grappler in the UFC with near perfect takedown entries.
items.quote: He is an excellent grappler. In fact, I think he's the best grappler in the UFC. He's got near perfect takedown entries

items.claim: He effectively chains takedowns by starting with a single leg and switching to an inside trip to land in half guard.
items.quote: a lot of times he'll go in for like a single leg, and then he'll switch it to the inside trip, and that's where he ends up in half guard on people

items.claim: He maintains excellent top control and stays safe while advancing position by threatening submissions.
items.quote: Excellent control once he gets the fight to the mat and stay safe on top because when he's work looking to advance position, he's going to make you think that he's going for a submission.
